drafts.body:
Notes from a recent project:

SafePaste - Sensitive Data Detection Browser Extension

Built a Chrome extension using 25+ detection patterns to warn users about potential exposure of email addresses, credentials and API keys before submitting pasted content.

Achieved 93.7% accuracy across 150+ manual test cases, including checks for false positives; kept all detection local to the browser to protect sensitive content.

Refined detection rules through manual testing to reduce false positives, while allowing users to review flagged content and choose whether to proceed.
